records.subject: Confirming cancellation for Blue Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Confirming that Blue Dynamics' Wrenfield subscription has been canceled as requested. If you change your mind, you can always come back.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: Quick check-in from Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Checking in on how Blue Dynamics is settling into Wrenfield. If anything feels clunky or confusing, I'd genuinely like to hear about it.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Blue Dynamics set up
records.body:
Hi Zara,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero customer replies to two outreach emails (email:b70cca7b, email:1e0ccc70) despite a held welcome call (calendar:4339cece); no project, no invite, no tickets. Engaged enough to attend a call, but no self-driven product action yet, so unaided activation in 8 days is possible but unlikely.

draft.subject: One small next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks again for the welcome call last week. I know a new tool is easy to park when the week gets full, so here's the smallest possible starting point: projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so one real project with a few tasks is usually enough to tell whether it fits how Blue Dynamics works.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through setting up that first project with you and answer anything that came up since we talked.

Best,
Nadia
